summary: An NSE index in Quote mode: the index frame carries LTP, OHLC, the previous close and the change worked out from them.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358); the desktop's common carrier has no such field, so it is lost.
deviations.ref: audit C06; WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md 'Verified broker fields dropped' (mstock)

deviations.reason: The web sends the previous close twice, as close and as prev_close (mstock_adapter.py:367-368); the desktop sends close only, and its dialect table has no prev_close alias for mStock.

mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:370, quote_data.get('oi', 0) with the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out of a frame whose packet has none, and sends the real OI from a full packet.
deviations.ref: docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md (a field the broker does not carry is left out); web openalgo#2376

deviations.reason: An index frame carries the recorded Zerodha index shape on the desktop for every broker: no last_quantity, average_price or book totals (feed::protocol::market_data, index branch). mStock's index Quote packet carries those fields as 0, which the web passes on.
